text: {"score":4,"justification":"Numbers match the card: 20.4% of 240 claims, expected 2.3%, risk-adjusted score 6.51, z 2.93, 59% low-complexity, 18 documented, 4 of 5 below billed, 0 of 8. Cited claims support their sentences: C0106088, C0106106 and C0106178 are documented-below-billed 99215s, and C0106074, C0106078 and C0106081 are low-complexity 99215s. The language is cautious (\"consistent with\", \"not a finding\") and next steps are concrete. Weaknesses: the comparison-provider 0% is stated without noting that it is a rate across all providers; the sample of 5 documented 99215 claims is small and the summary does not flag this; the \"0 of 8 had no lab line\" sentence is confusing and ambiguous; no high-complexity 99215 claims are shown for contrast, and no documentation gaps beyond the missing-minutes notes are flagged; the examples are all from the same pattern.","problems":["Small sample (5 documented 99215 claims) not flagged as a limitation; 80% headline could overstate strength.","The 0 of 8 data-review sentence is awkwardly worded and its meaning is unclear to an investigator (it reads as a non-finding but is not interpreted).","Does not mention that only 7.5% of claims have records, so documentation evidence is thin relative to the 240 claims.","Low-complexity examples (C0106074, C0106078, C0106081) have no documentation, so they support only the complexity mismatch, not documentation findings; the summary does not distinguish this.","Comparison 0% is described as 'comparison providers' without noting it is based on the all-provider rate."]}
